matches.rationale: The finding discusses Lemma 1/Theorem 1 in Section 3.2/Appendix B regarding the excess-risk bound proof, not the inconsistent definition of the projection function ψ across learner types described in Section 3.1/3.3/Table 1. Different locus entirely.

The finding directly targets Lemma 1 and Theorem 1's claim that minimizing L_c reduces the excess risk upper bound, arguing the derivation is non-rigorous and relies on unjustified approximations and unstated symmetry assumptions — the same theoretical claim flagged in the ground truth as lacking proper assumptions/rigor, just described from the angle of unjustified proof steps rather than omitted assumptions.
No finding addresses the sampling strategy π_κ for subsets used in inner-task distance computation; this material is not mentioned at all.
